scope: Independent browser attempt; no DOM/WebGL/model or firmware rendering acceptance.
attempt: Open a local overlay static development server in a new cloud-browser tab.
observed: Acquiring the resulting error tab was rejected by the browser URL security policy, which explicitly prohibited alternate-surface or indirect workarounds.
action: Stopped browser activity and the temporary local server. No policy workaround, browser reset, rendering claim or user-session change.
followup: Use an independently authorized preview URL reachable by the browser. Existing Node form checks use a simulated DOM and are not real-browser verification.
